id.description: Unique identifier of the alert. Required for update operations.

entity_type.description: Type of entity the alert is associated with

recipients.description: List of notification recipients. At least one recipient is required.

events.description: List of events that trigger the alert. At least one event is required.

associated_entities.description: List of entities associated with this alert. Use relation_type 'all' to apply to all AutoStopping rules, or 'specific' with entity_id to target specific rules.

AlertEntity.description: Defines which entities (AutoStopping rules) the alert applies to. Use 'all' to apply to all rules, or 'specific' with entity_id to target specific rules.

AlertEntityAll.description: Apply alert to all AutoStopping rules in the account

id.description: Unique identifier of the alert entity (auto-generated, not required in requests)

alert_id.description: ID of the parent alert (auto-generated, not required in requests)

relation_type.description: Must be 'all' to apply alert to all AutoStopping rules

AlertEntitySpecific.description: Apply alert to a specific AutoStopping rule by ID

id.description: Unique identifier of the alert entity (auto-generated, not required in requests)

alert_id.description: ID of the parent alert (auto-generated, not required in requests)

relation_type.description: Must be 'specific' to target individual rules

entity_id.description: ID of the specific AutoStopping rule. This is the rule ID (numeric string).

id.description: Unique identifier for this event configuration. Can be any string to identify this event entry.

event.description: Type of event that triggers the alert

ids.description: List of recipient identifiers. For email: email addresses. For slack: Slack channel IDs or webhook URLs.
